units.source_text: 女子没有答应他的要求，两臂交叉压在他所要求的东西上，像上了门闩似的。

en.t: The woman did not comply with his request; she crossed her arms over the thing he was asking for and pressed down on it, as though she had bolted a door.

units.source_text: 也许因为酩酊大醉，她已经使不上劲儿了。

en.t: Perhaps because she was dead drunk, she no longer had any strength left.
